scope: Pinned source-call/data-flow inspection; no training, model-output inspection or manuscript-run reproduction

findings.observation: Family construction and occurrence consolidation precede repeated selection on the supplied input genomes.
findings.adaptation: Fit vocabulary and consolidation separately within each outer training partition.

findings.observation: Each RFE fits its training rows; selected-feature occurrences are then pooled and reduced tables retain all rows. Later modelling resplits them.
findings.consequence: Later held-out rows can have influenced earlier pooled selection; these splits alone are not an untouched final test.

findings.observation: Disabled clustering or filter_type none uses row-random splitting; missing features or invalid grouped splits can fall back to it.
findings.adaptation: Use explicit frozen relatedness partitions and reject invalid splits.

findings.observation: Candidate fitting uses the supplied test rows for early stopping and candidate selection by MCC.
findings.adaptation: Treat them as tuning rows; reserve outer evaluation. The minimal component instead uses fixed iterations without an eval_set.

findings.observation: RFE defaults to log10 weights when weights_method is omitted; a grid-search call can retain default random_state42.
findings.adaptation: Record and pass weights and seed explicitly for each training-only fit.

findings.observation: CLI and lower-level Python defaults differ. Inspected notebook code did not establish the manuscript training invocation.
findings.consequence: Do not attribute a generic wrapper path or its potential validation optimism to the published runs without that execution evidence.

decision: Reuse the representation and selected fitting primitives with explicit train-only orchestration; do not use the default wrapper resplits as this project untouched external evaluation.
